subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in GGIR Package - "Nwindows Not Found"

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in GGIR Package - "Nwindows Not Found"
parts:
Hi Tim,

Did you try running GGIR with default settings by deleting the config.csv file and running your script with only the minimum number of parameters? Did that give the same error?

If yes, could you share an .RData file from the output subfolder meta/basic that would allow me to investigate the issue?

Thanks,

Vincent

On Tuesday, 17 September 2024 at 3:48 PM, Tim Balder <balde...@gmail.com> wrote:

Used accelerometer: Movisens (Move 3)

Used GGIR Version: 3.1.4 .

Dear all,

I am reaching out to the GGIR community seeking assistance with an issue I've encountered while working with the R package.

During the calculation of part 5 the following error message occurs:
---
 Errors and warnings for 332.RData$message [1] "Object 'Nwindows' not found" $call main_part5(i, metadatadir, f0, f1, params_sleep, params_metrics, params_247, params_phyact, params_cleaning, params_output, params_general, ms5.out, ms5.outraw, fnames.ms3, sleeplog, logs_diaries, extractfilenames, referencefnames, folderstructure, fullfilenames, foldername, ffdone, verbose)

---

This issue arose during my second run, where I adjusted the timewindow argument from "WW" to "WW, MM". The first run, where I used "WW" as the argument, completed without any errors.

I would greatly appreciate any guidance or advice from the community, especially if someone has encountered a similar issue. If further information is needed to diagnose the problem, please don't hesitate to ask.

Thank you in advance for your help.

Best regards,
Tim Balder
